definitions.explanation: The electrical signals produced by the brain, measurable through electroencephalography (EEG). Used in medical, scientific, and popular contexts.

examples.japanese: {脳波|のうは}を{測定|そくてい}する。
{睡眠中|すいみんちゅう}の{脳波|のうは}のパターンを{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: We examined brain wave patterns during sleep.

examples.japanese: {脳波|のうは}{検査|けんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{異常|いじょう}は{見|み}つからなかった。
examples.english: The brain wave test results showed no abnormalities.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in medical contexts ({脳波|のうは}{検査|けんさ} — EEG test) as well as popular science and technology discussions. Also appears in casual contexts related to brain-computer interfaces and neuroscience topics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脳波|のうは}{検査|けんさ} (EEG test, brain wave test)
- {脳波|のうは}を{測定|そくてい}する (to measure brain waves)
- {脳波|のうは}のパターン (brain wave pattern)
- アルファ{波|は} (alpha waves)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脳|のう}: brain — the organ itself
- {脳波|のうは}: brain waves — the electrical signals it produces
